svg.title: Field notes: how assistants leak
svg.desc: A system prompt shown as redaction bars while a scan line recovers the text beneath. Two 2025 research entries: a red-team audit of a production AI assistant that recovered its full system prompt, and a comparison of six consumer assistants.

g.text: FIG. 2 · A SYSTEM PROMPT, REDACTED THEN RECOVERED
Full system prompt recovered · 5 findings reported to the vendor
2025 · SIX CONSUMER ASSISTANTS, ONE PROMPT FAMILY
3 returned instruction-like text · 2 refused · 1 returned nothing
